default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1068.title: Round-number poke rejection
E-1068.hypothesis: Index points at multiples of 250/500/1000 attract resting orders; a bar that pokes the next round level and closes back is a failed push through offers/bids there. Fade it.

E-1069.title: Lunch-range break follow
E-1069.hypothesis: The thin 12-13h range holds balanced inventory; the first close beyond it after 13h is the return of participants with direction, follow.

E-1070.title: Absorption bar break
E-1070.hypothesis: High volume with a small range means one side absorbed the other's aggression; the break of that bar on the next bar shows which side ran out.

E-1071.title: Index and dollar rising together fade
E-1071.hypothesis: The index and the dollar normally move opposite; a joint unusual move in one direction is flow or risk-off noise that tends to revert on the index.

E-1072.title: Keltner band re-entry fade
E-1072.hypothesis: A close outside an ATR band around the EMA followed by a close back inside marks a spent stretch; fade toward the mean.

E-1073.title: Band squeeze release follow
E-1073.hypothesis: Bollinger width far below its usual level means compression; the first close beyond the band after it releases the stored move in that direction.

E-1074.title: Narrowest-bar break (NR4/NR7)
E-1074.hypothesis: A bar with the narrowest range of the last n bars shows quiet; the next bar closing beyond it starts the expansion (Crabel).

E-1075.title: Same-minute bar-colour seasonality
E-1075.hypothesis: If bars at this minute of the day were mostly one colour over the last 20 sessions, scheduled flows (news, opening of other markets) repeat; trade that colour.

E-1076.title: TRIX zero-line cross
E-1076.hypothesis: Triple-smoothed rate of change filters noise; a zero cross marks a persistent turn in drift that slower participants chase.

E-1077.title: Wide channel midpoint cross follow
E-1077.hypothesis: When the rolling high-low channel is wider than usual, crossing its midpoint shows control moving to the other half of an active range; follow.
